'''Sep Elopor''' was a ringed [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. At least 32 [[Moon/Legends|moons]] were known to orbit the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Unifying Force/Legends|Unifying Force]]'' states that Sep Elopor was the outermost planet in the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]], however, ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'' lists two planets in further orbits.
